title: Tickets from your own app
summary: Your app or website's server sends each customer's message to a web address; it becomes a numbered ticket, and the number comes back at once.
description: Your app or website's own server calls this workflow's web address with the customer's message (subject, message, their name, email and phone, and the department they chose, as JSON), signed with the key Taskiem shows with the workflow. Each call becomes a ticket with a number (T-1042), saved in your tickets table, and the number comes back in the answer, so your app can show it. Your departments work as in the other helpdesk templates, and the customer is told their number too. Give the address of your A helpdesk on your Taskiem email address workflow, and answers go by email from it, with the customer's replies joining their ticket; otherwise they go on WhatsApp, Telegram, by text or by a plain email. Your team answers with the Answer customers' tickets form.

variables.name: ticket_reply_form
variables.why: The link of your ticket reply form (the Answer customers' tickets workflow), put in each message to a department so they can answer at once.

params.name: departments
params.title: Departments
params.description: One department per line: its name, the role whose members answer its tickets, what it looks after, and words that send a ticket there, separated by a | sign. For example: Billing | accounts | Payments, invoices and refunds | refund, invoice, payment
params.example:
Billing | accounts | Payments, invoices and refunds | refund, invoice, payment, charged
Delivery | dispatch | Orders on their way, late or damaged deliveries | delivery, late, rider, damaged
General | support | Anything else |

params.name: default_department
params.title: Department when none fits
params.description: One of your departments, by its name: it gets the tickets that fit no other.

params.name: routing
params.title: How a ticket finds its department
params.description: ai: Taskiem's AI reads the message and picks the department, how urgent it is and a one-line summary. rules (the default): the first department with one of its words in the message. chosen: the department the customer picked.

params.name: acknowledgement
params.title: What the customer is told first
params.description: The first answer a customer gets when they write; their ticket's reference is added after it.
params.default: Thank you for getting in touch. We have your message and will answer you soon.
params.example: Thank you for getting in touch. We have your message and will answer you soon.

params.name: helpdesk_address
params.title: Your helpdesk's Taskiem email address (optional)
params.description: The email address of your A helpdesk on your Taskiem email address workflow. With it, customers get your answers by email from that address, and their replies join their ticket. Without it, they get your answers on WhatsApp, Telegram, by text or by a plain email.

params.name: path
params.title: Web address path
params.description: The path your app or website's server calls.

definition.name: Helpdesk webhook
definition.description: Opens a ticket for each message your app or website sends, and answers with its number.

external_id.title: Your app's id for the message
external_id.description: Given back in the answer, to match the ticket to your record

steps.name: Answer your app with the ticket's number
